title: On the Ricci symmetries of a Kähler manifold
summary: The main purpose of the present paper is to investigate the symmetry properties of a Kähler manifold involving the Ricci tensor. In this context, the most symmetric manifolds are Kähler-Einstein spaces, and their natural generalizations are Ricci-parallel Kähler manifolds, Ricci-semisymmetric Kähler manifolds and holomorphically Ricci-pseudosymmetric Kähler manifolds.
